anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: First month; fourteenth; sheep by houses.

pass_a_gloss: This month God says to Moses and Aaron is beginning of months, and first in the year's months for them, when they come out of Egypt. And as far as the history, this same is first month, and the Jews keep this feast yearly on the fourteenth of the first month, by houses a sheep according to the law given them through Moses, sacrificing.
pass_b_english: This month, God says to Moses and Aaron, is a beginning of months, and first among the months of the year for them, when they come out of Egypt. And as far as the history goes, this same month is first, and the Jews keep this feast every year on the fourteenth of the first month, household by household, sacrificing a sheep according to the law given them through Moses.
